First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: relaxed, social. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Slow Spokes Friday Ride in Lockport group ride

Friday evening slow ride along the canal town of Lockport. Same format as the other Slow Spokes nights: easy pace, all bikes, a stop or two, back to the cafe.
